widgets_values: In the studio, a gradient gray background is paired with geometric light and shadow lines to create a high - end magazine aesthetic. A full - body front - facing composition of a 21 - year - old Chinese male internet celebrity blogger. He wears a slim - fit white trendy brand printed T - shirt (the tight fit accentuates muscle lines), paired with loose, distressed gray straight - leg jeans (the pants drape down to the shoe surface), and classic Adidas sports shoes. A hard - edged main light shines diagonally at a 45° angle from the upper - side, enhancing the three - dimensional contours of the face and the contrast between light and shadow of the clothing. A ring light softens the skin texture, while background lighting projects cool - toned neon line shadows, creating a futuristic atmosphere. The subject has one hand in his pocket, the other hand gently tugging at the collar, chin slightly raised, eyes sharply meeting the camera. His hair appears naturally disheveled due to the dynamic pose. The overall look emphasizes the trendy contrast of "tight top + loose bottom" to showcase a visual impact that blends street coolness with magazine - worthy fashion.

He is wearing a white T-shirt with a black graphic design featuring a stylized drawing of a man and the word "SINGING" in bold, black letters across the chest. His jeans are light blue with a faded effect, and he is wearing light blue Adidas sneakers with white stripes and brown soles. His hands are casually tucked into the pockets of his jeans. The background is simple, with the lighting creating a subtle shadow of the man on the wall behind him, adding depth to the image. The overall style of the photograph is modern and minimalistic, focusing on the subject without any additional props or distractions.
